10862.subject: Technical Drawing
10862.question_text: Construct a perpendicular bisector to a line segment AB of length 60 mm. Label all construction lines and points clearly.
10862.explanation:
1. Draw line segment AB = 60 mm.
2. With A as center, draw an arc above and below AB with radius > 30 mm.
3. With B as center, draw arcs intersecting the previous arcs at points C and D.
4. Join C and D to form the perpendicular bisector.
5. Label all points and construction lines.

10863.subject: Technical Drawing
10863.question_text: Construct a regular hexagon with side length 30 mm using the circumscribed circle method. Show all construction lines.
10863.explanation:
1. Draw a circle with radius = 30 mm.
2. Mark a point A on the circumference.
3. Using the same radius, step off points B, C, D, E, and F on the circumference.
4. Join the points to form the hexagon.
5. Label all points and construction lines.

10864.subject: Technical Drawing
10864.question_text: Construct a tangent to a circle of radius 25 mm from an external point P, 50 mm from the center of the circle. Show all construction lines.
10864.explanation:
1. Draw the circle with center O and radius 25 mm.
2. Mark point P 50 mm from O.
3. Join OP and bisect it to find midpoint M.
4. With M as center, draw a semicircle on OP to intersect the original circle at T and T'.
5. Join PT and PT' as the required tangents.
6. Label all points and construction lines.

10865.subject: Technical Drawing
10865.question_text: Draw the front, top, and side views of the given isometric block (assume dimensions: 40 mm × 30 mm × 20 mm). Use first-angle projection.
10865.explanation:
1. Front view: Rectangle 40 mm × 20 mm.
2. Top view: Rectangle 40 mm × 30 mm.
3. Side view: Rectangle 30 mm × 20 mm.
4. Align views correctly in first-angle projection.
5. Label all views and dimensions.

10866.subject: Technical Drawing
10866.question_text: Draw a full sectional front view of the given object (assume a hollow cylinder with outer diameter 50 mm, inner diameter 30 mm, and height 40 mm). Use appropriate hatching.
10866.explanation:
1. Draw the outer rectangle 50 mm × 40 mm.
2. Draw the inner rectangle 30 mm × 40 mm.
3. Apply 45° hatching to the sectioned area.
4. Label dimensions and section lines.

10867.subject: Technical Drawing
10867.question_text: Draw an isometric view of a cube with side length 35 mm. Show all hidden edges with dashed lines.
10867.explanation:
1. Draw the top face as a rhombus with 30° angles.
2. Project vertical edges downward.
3. Complete the bottom face.
4. Show hidden edges with dashed lines.
5. Label all edges and dimensions.

10868.subject: Technical Drawing
10868.question_text: Develop the lateral surface of a square pyramid with base side 30 mm and slant height 50 mm. Show all construction lines.
10868.explanation:
1. Draw the base square.
2. Draw four isosceles triangles with base 30 mm and sides 50 mm.
3. Join the triangles to form the net.
4. Label all dimensions and construction lines.

10869.subject: Technical Drawing
10869.question_text: Draw the line of interpenetration between a vertical cylinder (diameter 40 mm) and a horizontal cylinder (diameter 30 mm) intersecting at right angles. Show all construction lines.
10869.explanation:
1. Draw the orthographic views of both cylinders.
2. Divide the circles into equal parts.
3. Project points to find intersections.
4. Draw the curve of interpenetration.
5. Label all points and construction lines.

10870.subject: Technical Drawing
10870.question_text: Dimension the given orthographic views of a block (40 mm × 30 mm × 20 mm) using standard dimensioning conventions. Include all necessary dimensions.
10870.explanation:
1. Dimension overall sizes (40 mm, 30 mm, 20 mm).
2. Use extension lines and dimension lines.
3. Place dimensions outside the views where possible.
4. Use arrowheads and clear text.
5. Follow standard dimensioning conventions.

10871.subject: Technical Drawing
10871.question_text: Sketch freehand the isometric view of a hexagonal prism with side length 20 mm and height 40 mm. Show all visible edges.
10871.explanation:
1. Sketch the top hexagon with 30° angles.
2. Project vertical edges downward.
3. Complete the bottom hexagon.
4. Ensure proportions are maintained.
5. Show all visible edges clearly.
